status: unratified candidate; cartographic geometry check only
purpose: Connect eight candidate main channels to the nearest visible coastline in the actual source-contour ∩ fracture-land mask. Identify five strictly geometric coastline appearance zones along the protected core without establishing geology.
method: Stream model local points receive existing river-group translations; coast and fracture mask paths receive the relevant land-fragment translations. Each candidate mouth either extends an interior terminal directly to the nearest shore with sampled land containment, or follows the first river segment exiting the visible land and bisects that segment to the coastline. The bridge is drawn in the source parent transform. No historical river path, core geographic anchor or original V2.25 contour is rewritten.
masks: originalClip1/originalClip4 with fracture-1-[0..1]/fracture-4-[0..2] shifted by each displayed land fragment transform
